en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a grand, arched gate with intricate stonework and a coat of arms above it. The gate is part of a larger brick building with medieval architectural features, including crenellations and pointed turrets. The street beside the building is cobblestoned and empty. In the background, a massive church tower rises, indicating historical European architecture.
